verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users ask questions, troubleshoot, and explore telemetry in plain language, and the new MCP server explicitly converts natural-language questions into NRQL queries to retrieve results without requiring NRQL expertise. This directly delivers natural-language operation of the product for querying and troubleshooting. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the natural-language assistant's accuracy and broader coverage beyond querying (e.g., configuring alerts or dashboards via NL commands).
